title_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment at Orbital Complex 2, Boulevard i RI!
description_en: FOR SALE 2+1 APARTMENT ON THE 2nd FLOOR, NEW BULEVARD! The apartment is located on the second residential floor or the third from the ground in the Orbital 2 Complex, of the Gener 2 company. The building is in the brick phase. The apartment is in the stage of tiling, installing doors and windows. With a total area of ​​91 m2 and a net of 79 m2, the apartment has a very regular layout and is organized by a distribution corridor, two bedrooms, bathroom, storage room, living room + kitchen area and a loggia balcony. The apartment is oriented from inside the complex with a view of the flower garden and the grounds of the palace. The building has: Thermal insulation 24-hour security system 2 floors of underground parking RCC structure resistant to earthquakes Emergency exit Staircase with fire protection Deadline for completion of works, January 2026. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us! Gold120608
